title: Hasty Irish Swede Stew
description: Nutty and snappy, this quick-fix Irish stew packs swede, carrots, and spices into a macrobiotic-friendly cazuela for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a cazuela over medium heat.
Add onion, carrot, and celery, sautéing until the onion turns translucent.
Stir in the diced swede and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Add cumin, thyme, salt, and pepper, then reduce heat to low.
Cover the cazuela and let the stew simmer for 25 minutes, until the swede is tender.
Fold in the chopped spinach, stirring until it wilts, about 3 minutes.
Taste the stew and adjust seasoning if necessary.
Serve hot straight from the cazuela for a rustic presentation.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh thyme if desired.
